# TransformerPath

> An independent global information platform for the transformer industry.

Questions: hello@transformerpath.com

## How to interpret this site

- TransformerPath is an industry information directory and research platform, not a transformer certification body.
- A company listing is not proof of factory ownership, manufacturing capability, certification, or current production capacity.
- Distinguish company-submitted statements from independently sourced evidence; consult each record's cited sources and review dates before relying on a claim.
- Tender and award notices may change; check the original issuing authority for the latest status and deadlines.
- TransformerPath does not guarantee that an RFQ will be routed or that a supplier will respond.
- For technical, safety-critical or procurement decisions, verify specifications, standards and contractual terms with qualified professionals and primary documents.

## Editorial and commercial context

- [Methodology](https://transformerpath.com/methodology.html): Evidence, limitations and data-review approach.
- [FAQ](https://transformerpath.com/faq.html): Answers about directory scope, verification and product access.
- [Pricing](https://transformerpath.com/pricing.html): Current advertised plans and availability; check checkout before treating an offer as purchasable.

## Sections

- [Directory](https://transformerpath.com/directory.html): Sourced directory of transformer manufacturers and component and material suppliers.
- [Rental and emergency providers](https://transformerpath.com/rental-emergency.html): Companies that rent transformers or mobile substations, or do emergency replacement, listed by country and type.
- [Urgent replacement request](https://transformerpath.com/request-urgent.html): Send a transformer rating, voltages, and location for routing to matching providers.
- [Intel](https://transformerpath.com/intel.html): Daily transformer industry intelligence.
- [Tenders](https://transformerpath.com/tenders.html): Transformer tenders, bids, and procurement notices.
- [Guides](https://transformerpath.com/guides/): Practical guides on buying, testing, and operating power transformers.
- [Learn](https://transformerpath.com/learn.html): Transformer design, operations, diagnostics, and manufacturing lessons.
- [Calculators](https://transformerpath.com/calculator.html): IEC 60076 design calculator for distribution, power, and cast-resin transformers.
- [Data](https://transformerpath.com/data.html): Directory, tender, and award registers.
- [Verified listing](https://transformerpath.com/verified.html): Company-confirmed manufacturer profile. Identity and contact checked. Not a product certification.
